title: Validator fee will be lost if recipient is not set
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it will result in a loss of yield for a validator  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a specific scenario  ## Description  In `GaugeProxy::distributeToken` rewards are distributed to gauges based on validator activity. Also some fee is taken, called a `validatorFee`, and sent to a different recipient for each validator.
